summary.text: David C. "Dave" Graham is the Republican nominee. A U.S. Army and Delaware National Guard veteran and former certified public accountant who has worked for the Delaware Department of Finance since 2003, he is not a lawyer; the Delaware Constitution does not require the Attorney General to be one.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Army and Delaware National Guard.
Has about 25 years of experience as a certified public accountant and has worked for the Delaware Department of Finance since 2003.
Ran as a write-in candidate for governor in 2012, as the Independent Party candidate for Attorney General in 2014 (about 2.1% of the vote), and sought the 2020 Republican nomination for governor.

sources.title: DEGOP names veteran Dave Graham as attorney general candidate
